title: Not structured
text: Not structured. The photos give the impression that it's got some structure to it, like most of the christmas storage things on Amazon. But really you're just buying a huge cheap duffle bag. No structure means you can't stack in any fashion, and who's got room for that? Returning.

product_metadata.title: HOLIDAY SPIRIT Christmas Tree Storage Bag - Heavy-Duty Tree Bag with Durable Reinforced Handles & Zipper, Waterproof Storage Bag Protects from Moisture & Dust (Fits a 7.5FT Tree, Charcoal)
features: LARGE CHRISTMAS TREE STORAGE BAG – Easily store your artificial Christmas tree at the end of the year with the Holiday Spirit Christmas Tree Bag. Great for your tree, garlands, and even lights. Dimensions: 48” x 15” x 20” - Fits up to a 7.5ft Christmas tree

SAFELY STORE & PROTECT YOUR TREE – Most artificial Christmas trees are used for years and years so you want to make sure your investment is protected. Our tree storage bags keep your trees fully protected from dust, moisture, and even small critters

HEAVY-DUTY CANVAS – Built with extremely durable dual layer 600d oxford canvas material that prevents tears and is 100% waterproof. No matter if you store your Christmas tree storage bag in your garage, attic, shed, or home, your tree will be ready for next holiday season

REINFORCED HANDLES – The Holiday Spirit Christmas Tree Bag features 3-stitch reinforced handles that make it easy to carry the storage bag anywhere. Durability you can trust no matter how heavy the bag

STURDY DUAL ZIPPER – Our Christmas storage bag features a smooth operating dual zipper that allows you to open the bag wide enough to easily fit your tree. No worries of damaging your tree while placing it inside the storage bag
